tasks.title: Define TestifyConfigurationViewModel contract and load/save interface
acceptance: ViewModel exposes properties for omit fields list, preferred values map, CE poll timeout (int seconds), and partial enum coverage toggle
ViewModel constructor calls load against TestifyConfigurationStore for the given map key
SaveCommand is defined and invokes store write
No XAML or UI code in this task — ViewModel and store wiring only
constraints: No UI changes in this task
Must handle missing config (show defaults on first load)

tasks.title: Add CE poll timeout validation (5–300 s) to TestifyConfigurationViewModel
acceptance: SaveCommand is disabled / returns validation error when timeout < 5 or > 300
Unit test asserts boundary values 4, 5, 300, 301 produce correct valid/invalid states
constraints: Validation logic must live in ViewModel, not in XAML

tasks.title: Build XAML settings panel UserControl for Testify configuration
acceptance: UserControl binds to TestifyConfigurationViewModel
All four fields (omit list, preferred values, poll timeout, partial enum toggle) are present and editable
Save button triggers SaveCommand and shows inline confirmation message
Panel is accessible from DualWriteMapBrowser main toolbar without navigating away from map list

tasks.title: Add integration test for TestifyConfiguration round-trip fidelity
acceptance: Test writes all four settings fields via ViewModel, reloads ViewModel, asserts all values match
Test covers first-write scenario (no prior config) and overwrite scenario
All assertions pass under dotnet test with no parallelism issues

tasks.title: Add rollback method to Testify runner triggered on post-creation failure
tasks.notes: Added TestifyRunner.RollbackAsync (internal static) that clears LastEntityInstanceUrl unconditionally before DELETE (404=success). Updated FinalizeTestifyFailureAsync to call it. All 4 acceptance criteria met: DELETE issued, 404=success, cache cleared regardless, original exception re-thrown at call site (unchanged). 7 rollback tests pass.
acceptance: Rollback method issues DELETE to F&O OData endpoint for lastEntityInstanceUrl
404 response during DELETE is treated as success (no error raised)
lastEntityInstanceUrl cache key is cleared regardless of DELETE outcome
Original failure exception is re-thrown after cleanup completes
constraints: Rollback must not suppress the original failure — re-throw after cleanup

tasks.title: Integrate rollback into Testify runner failure path (PATCH and CE-verification phases)
acceptance: Any exception or non-success result raised after record creation triggers rollback before surfacing
Rollback is not triggered for failures that occur before record creation
Runner does not swallow exceptions after rollback completes

tasks.title: Add stale-URL validation to Testify run entry point
acceptance: Run entry point issues HEAD or GET against cached lastEntityInstanceUrl before using it
404 response invalidates the cached URL and proceeds as a fresh run
Non-404 error during pre-validation is surfaced as a run error, not silently ignored

tasks.title: Write FakeODataServer tests for rollback and idempotent rerun scenarios
acceptance: Test: stale/deleted lastEntityInstanceUrl — run proceeds cleanly, cache cleared
Test: failure after record creation triggers DELETE, original error surfaced, cache cleared
Test: 404 during rollback DELETE does not raise secondary error
All tests use FakeODataServer harness, no real HTTP calls
All tests pass deterministically under repeated dotnet test runs

tasks.title: Add EnumCoverageGap collection to TestifyPlanner output model
acceptance: TestifyPlanner output type carries a non-null EnumCoverageGap collection
Each gap entry has FieldName (string) and UnmappedValue (string or enum member identifier)
No planner analysis logic changed in this task — model definition only

tasks.title: Implement enum gap collection in TestifyPlanner field-mapping analysis phase
acceptance: Planner enumerates all unmapped enum members for every mapped field during Prepare phase
Gaps are populated on the output before any test record is created
Existing partial-coverage warning is retained and supplemented with gap detail
Unit test asserts gap collection is populated correctly for a known mapping with missing members

tasks.title: Add 'Blocked: incomplete coverage' and 'Blocked: missing entity' discrete states to TestifyResultRow
acceptance: TestifyResultRow has two new distinct blocked state values
Coverage-blocked state carries structured detail payload: field name and unmapped values list
Missing-entity blocked state carries actionable detail message
No grid renderer changes in this task

tasks.title: Update result grid renderer to display enum gap detail inline for coverage-blocked rows
acceptance: Coverage-blocked rows display field name and unmapped values as comma-separated list inline in the grid
Missing-entity blocked rows display their actionable detail message
Non-blocked rows are unaffected by renderer changes

tasks.title: Write FakeODataServer tests for enum gap reporting and payload trimming edge cases
acceptance: Test: planner output contains correct gap entries for a mapping with unmapped members
Test: result row state is 'Blocked: incomplete coverage' when gaps exist and partial coverage is off
Test: payload trimming with null fields, empty collections, and fields in omit list produces correct trimmed payload
All tests in DualWriteMapBrowserTestifyTests.cs, no new test infrastructure required
All tests pass deterministically

tasks.title: Write deterministic FakeODataServer test for CE poll timeout expiry
acceptance: Test uses injected clock or configurable timeout value — no real wall-time sleep
Test asserts result row state is a deterministic timeout result when CE poll expires
Test passes without flakiness under repeated runs
Added to DualWriteMapBrowserTestifyTests.cs
constraints: Must not use Thread.Sleep or Task.Delay with real durations — inject controllable clock

tasks.title: Lock ProductCode, UpgradeCode, and Bundle GUIDs in WiX/Burn installer source
acceptance: Three GUIDs generated (ProductCode, UpgradeCode, Bundle) and committed to installer source
GUIDs are static values — not generated at build time
No other packaging changes in this task
constraints: GUIDs must be locked before any other packaging change to prevent upgrade-path breaks
This task must be completed before T16 and T17

tasks.title: Add signtool integration to install/build.ps1 for MSI and bundle signing
acceptance: Script accepts -CertThumbprint parameter
Script locates signtool.exe via Windows SDK path
Script signs MSI, then signs Burn bundle
Script fails the build (non-zero exit) if signing fails
Script emits summary of signed artifacts and their thumbprints to stdout
signtool verify succeeds on both artifacts after script completes

tasks.title: Chain .NET 8 Desktop Runtime redistributable in Burn bootstrapper with hash verification
acceptance: Burn chain references .NET 8 Desktop Runtime installer by resolved local path or verified download URL
Download URL path includes hash check
Version condition is specified in the chain element
Build succeeds and resulting bundle is accepted by update channel endpoint without modification

tasks.title: Add interactive auth fallback for MsalUiRequiredException and invalid_grant in auth service
acceptance: Auth service catches MsalUiRequiredException and MsalServiceException with error code invalid_grant
Fallback initiates device code flow when no interactive session is available, browser prompt otherwise
Fallback strategy is configurable per environment profile (device code preferred / browser preferred / prompt user)
Silent token failure does not return failure without attempting fallback first
constraints: Fallback must be attempted before returning any failure to callers

tasks.title: Wire auth-required event to host shell re-authentication modal dialog
acceptance: Auth service raises auth-required event when fallback is needed
Host shell subscribes to event and displays modal re-authentication dialog
Dialog blocks plugin operations until re-auth completes or user cancels
No HTTP 401 error surfaces in plugin result output after user completes re-auth

tasks.title: Implement per-tenant authority validation against token tid claim
acceptance: Auth service compares authority hostname derived from acquired token's tid claim against configured TenantId
Mismatch produces a named error type (not a generic exception)
Mismatch is caught before any API call is dispatched
User-readable error message is surfaced for mismatched tenant
Unit test covers: matching tenant passes, mismatched tenant produces named error before API call

tasks.title: Write unit tests for auth service fallback paths and tenant validation failure modes
acceptance: Test: MsalUiRequiredException triggers device code fallback when no interactive session
Test: invalid_grant error code triggers interactive fallback
Test: fallback strategy selection matches environment profile configuration
Test: tenant mismatch produces named error before any API call is made
Test: successful re-auth after fallback allows operation to proceed
All tests pass deterministically
